rootCauseAnalysis.why: This branch was a rescue attempt for uc-admin-sales-cockpit-admin that created an Express-side implementation of the Sales Cockpit API. PR #1844 (merged 2026-06-23) separately shipped a Next.js-based implementation of the same feature via the dashboard app. The task row for this rescue branch was likely deleted when the UC was considered done via #1844.
rootCauseAnalysis.fix: Branch is NOT a duplicate — it contains complementary server-side work. Recommend filing a PR to merge the Express routes + service class + unit tests, with the migration treated as no-op (table already exists via scripts/db/create-outreach-log-table.sql).
